app.name: FPO-SETU
app.tagline: What happened to my lot, and what was I paid?

lang.title: Choose your language
lang.sub: You can change it later from the top of the home screen.

login.title: Sign in with your phone
login.demoHint: This is a prototype. No real SMS is sent, so the OTP is shown here.

device.title: This phone is your signature
device.body: When you press "I confirm", this phone signs with a secret key. The key never leaves the phone, so nobody can sign for you. The ledger checks the signature.
device.failed: This phone could not make its signing key. Open the app in the phone's own browser over https, then try again.

home.emptyBody: When your VLE writes a lot in your name it shows up here. You confirm it with your phone.
home.loadFailed: Your lots could not be loaded.
home.listNote: Showing lots that have a draft or a payment statement.

lot.title: Lot
lot.pledgedBody: This lot is held as security for a loan. It cannot be sold on until the bank releases it.
lot.qrTitle: Pack QR for buyers and shoppers
lot.qrBody: Anyone who scans it sees where this lot came from. No name or phone number is shown.
lot.needsSignature: This lot is waiting for your signature.

confirm.title: Confirm this lot
confirm.intro: Your VLE {{vle}} wrote this lot in your name. If it is right, confirm it with this phone.
confirm.offlineWhy: The ledger is asleep, so signing is paused.
confirm.doneBody: Your signature is on the ledger. The lot is now recorded in your name.
confirm.declineBody: You have not signed, so this lot will not go on the ledger. Tell your VLE what is wrong. It will not appear in your waiting list on this phone.
confirm.declineUndo: I changed my mind, show it again
confirm.notFound: There is no lot waiting for you with this number.
confirm.payloadBad: This draft does not match what is shown, so this phone will not sign it. Ask your VLE to create it again.
confirm.reregister: Register this phone's signature again and retry
confirm.noKey: This phone has no signing key yet. Sign in again so one is made.

statement.title: Payment statement
statement.noVoice: This device has no Bengali voice. Please read the statement on the screen.
statement.noVoiceHi: This device has no Hindi voice. Please read the statement on the screen.
statement.noVoiceEn: This device has no English voice. Please read the statement on the screen.
statement.emptyBody: Your statement appears here after the buyer pays and the FPO shares the money.

say.intro: Statement for your {{crop}} lot. Weight {{kg}} kilograms. Grade {{grade}}.
say.paid: Paid on {{date}}. This payment reference is simulated.

proofDrawer.title: Proof on the ledger
proofDrawer.unavailable: The transaction details could not be loaded right now.

banner.indexOnly: The ledger node is asleep. You are seeing the last indexed state. Actions that write to the ledger are paused.
banner.offline: No connection to the server. Check your internet and try again.

toast.PatronageDistributed: Your statement for lot {{ref}} is ready

profile.title: Profile
profile.tokenNote: This is the only ID of yours that goes on the ledger. Your name and phone stay off it.

about.title: How FPO-SETU fits together
about.body: Six apps read and write one shared record through one gateway. The record lives on a Hyperledger Fabric network run by four organisations on three channels. This app is the farmer's window onto it.
about.chain: Farmer app, FPO console, bank portal, buyer portal, consumer site, governance dashboard  →  one gateway  →  Fabric (4 organisations, 3 channels)
about.here: You are here: the farmer app

credits.title: Credits
credits.body: This build uses no photographs or illustrations. Icons are from Lucide (ISC licence). Fonts: IBM Plex Sans, Noto Sans Bengali, Noto Sans Devanagari (SIL Open Font Licence), loaded from Google Fonts.

errors.NETWORK: The server cannot be reached. Check your internet and try again.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
errors.ERR_UNAUTHENTICATED: Your sign-in has ended. Sign in again with your phone number.
errors.ERR_FORBIDDEN_ROLE: This is not your lot, so it cannot be opened. Go back to your own lots.
errors.ERR_FORBIDDEN_ORG: You cannot see this. Go back to your own lots.
errors.ERR_VALIDATION: Something you entered is not right. Check it and try again.
errors.ERR_NOT_FOUND: That could not be found. Go back to home and look again.
errors.ERR_INVALID_STATE: This lot is not ready for that step. Go back to home to see its latest state.
errors.ERR_BAD_FARMER_SIGNATURE: The signature did not match the key on record. Choose "Register this phone's signature again" and retry.
errors.ERR_BAD_DEVICE_SIGNATURE: The weighing device signature did not match. Tell the FPO.
errors.ERR_LEDGER_UNAVAILABLE: The ledger is asleep, so this cannot be done now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.ERR_DOUBLE_FINANCING: This lot is already pledged. Wait for the bank to release it.
errors.ERR_LOT_PLEDGED: This lot is pledged to the bank. Wait for the bank to release it.
